# CalicoMusic — Mike Lewis

> Mike Lewis is a professional big band, orchestral, and vocal arranger, composer, conductor, and producer based
> in South Florida, active since 1970, with a performing career dating to 1960. He does not arrange rap or
> hip-hop.

## Key facts
- Born August 23, 1938, in Danville, Virginia.
- Composition major, Florida State University (1956–1960); Music Education degree, University of Miami (1965).
- Career highlights: Charlie Spivak Orchestra, Jimmy Dorsey Orchestra, arranger for The Jackie Gleason TV Show
  (1968–1970), freelance arranger/conductor/producer since 1970.
- Specialties: big band jazz orchestrations, symphony orchestra arrangements, Broadway-style arrangements,
  professional studio recordings, cruise ship productions, sequenced arrangements (Digital Performer).
- Notable clients as arranger/producer: Rod Stewart, KC and the Sunshine Band, Crosby Stills & Nash, Bee Gees,
  Ray Charles Orchestra, Royal Caribbean Cruise Lines, Glenn Miller Orchestra, Julio Iglesias, Willie Nelson,
  and 40+ others (full list on the About page).
- Earlier performing career alongside Frank Sinatra, Sammy Davis Jr., Ray Charles, Tony Bennett, and others.
- Latest production (2026): "May I Come In," a jazz album featuring vocalist Lisanne Lyons, released on OA2
  Records, arranged and produced by Mike Lewis.
